name: session-progress
description: Animated progress band for long-running turns, with a completion summary

stepRows.title: Step rows
stepRows.description: When the band lists the steps under its bar. auto: only for a Markdown plan's checkboxes, since Claude Code already draws its own task list. always: for task lists too. never: not at all.

eta.title: Countdown
eta.description: Whether the band counts down the work left. on: Claude reports what is left through the mod's progress tool, and the bar's label counts it down. off: no tool, no countdown; the bar shows the share of a plan done, as before.
